event.name: Sports World Cup Hackathon
event.description: Build innovative projects around sports, combining technology, creativity, and ideas to solve problems in the world of sports. Create, experiment, and compete with other builders.
event.location: Homebrew Club, 111 Maiden Ln #540, San Francisco, CA 94108

tracks.name: Athlete Performance & Coaching
tracks.description: ​Build tools that help athletes and coaches improve performance through AI, analytics, training, wearables, injury prevention, biomechanics, or video analysis.

tracks.name: Fan Experience & Engagement
tracks.description: Create products that enhance the fan experience through fantasy sports, social engagement, predictions, gamification, personalized content, or interactive viewing.

tracks.name: Media, Content & Broadcasting
tracks.description: Develop AI-powered solutions for sports commentary, highlights, content creation, broadcasting, multilingual coverage, or sports journalism.

tracks.name: Sports Business & Operations
tracks.description: ​Build products for leagues, clubs, tournaments, venues, sponsorships, ticketing, scheduling, scouting, operations, or sports analytics.

tracks.name: Open Innovation
tracks.description: ​Have an idea that doesn't fit the above tracks? Build any sports-related product.
